summary: Implemented Lambda (monai/transforms/utility/array.py) and Lambdad (monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py) with LambdaD and LambdaDict aliases, docs entries in docs/source/transforms.rst, and tests in tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py. Fixed two issues during the work: slicing tests now slice spatial axes only (x[:, :, 1:10, ::-2]), and a dropped space in the IdentityD alias line was restored. A diff against HEAD shows only the permitted changes in dictionary.py. Tests were not run and nothing was committed, per instructions.
